judge.identity: Codex independent reviewer; exact serving model identifier not exposed to this artifact
judge.separate_from_generator: HomeAtlas answers were generated by local qwen3-vl:4b-instruct; this review is by Codex with access to frozen synthetic source pages.

rubric.answer_correctness: 1 complete and accurate answer (or correct abstention on authored negative); 0.5 partially correct; 0 incorrect or false abstention on answerable question.
rubric.faithfulness: 1 all material factual claims supported by original cited page; 0.5 mixed support; 0 unsupported; null when there is no substantive factual answer.
rubric.answer_relevancy: 1 addresses the asked fact directly; 0.5 partially; 0 irrelevant; null for an authored negative abstention.
rubric.hallucination: true for explicit unsupported factual claim; false when supported or abstained; null when source unavailable.
rubric.abstention_appropriate: true for correct abstention on authored negative; false for answerable false refusal or positive answer; check answer_correctness alongside this field.
rubric.citation_claim_support: supported, partial, unsupported, or none for an abstention.

limitations: Bounded review of 12 saved synthetic table questions from one partial final run, not a population estimate or independent API-based RAGAS judge.
Original four-page synthetic PDF was read directly; cited page text and row-column relationships were checked, not merely citation string overlap.
All positive cases use simple, clean tables. This says nothing about complex, scanned, or real household tables.
The source result is a partial final generation run (43/60 PDF questions); no second final generation pass exists in this artifact.
